title: CYBRIK org edge v1 (D-5)
description: A typed governance/exchange edge between two nodes (ADR-0007 D-5; 02 §5-§6). Every edge is explicitly created, individually authorized, marking-/residency-checked where it moves data, time-bounded, revocable, and audited. Directional semantics: 'parent' (up->down governance, NO raw read, INV-1), 'escalation' (down->up object transfer/share), 'tasking' (up->down authority-to-direct, NO read), 'case-delegation' (peer scoped object share), 'exchange' (across the external trust boundary). from_node/to_node self-carry tenant + boundary so cross-tenant edges (OD-1) and external-as-ancestor (INV-2) are checkable. A 'parent' edge's parent (from_node) MUST be internal — an external authority can never be an ancestor. Same-tenant and acyclicity are enforced at runtime (a schema cannot compare two field values or walk a graph). $id uses the RFC 2606 .example documentation domain. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA). Accepted at Gate W2-G (Codex under Founder delegation, 2026-07-24).

edge_id.description: Opaque edge id. Revocation targets this id.

from_node.description: Source endpoint. For 'parent' this is the parent (ancestor); for 'escalation' the lower node; for 'tasking' the tasking (upper) node. The relying party MUST reject an edge whose from_node.tenant_binding differs from to_node.tenant_binding (no cross-tenant hierarchy edge, OD-1) and any edge whose endpoints form a cycle (including from_node == to_node).

confers_raw_read.description: Whether this edge grants raw read of the counterpart's records. 'parent' and 'tasking' edges MUST be false (governance/authority-to-direct, not read; INV-1). Raw access is only ever the specific escalated/delegated/exchanged object, via a scope grant.

object_ref.description: For escalation / case-delegation / exchange: the specific object transferred or shared, digest-bound. 'the higher node's access is exactly what was escalated, nothing more' (02 §5.2).

marking.description: Authoritative marking that travels with a data-moving edge. Marking/residency are re-checked on the crossing and never downgraded (runtime).

temporal.description: Every edge is time-bounded, revocable, audited (02 §6).

allOf.$comment: INV-2 / external-as-ancestor: a 'parent' (tier) edge's parent (from_node) MUST be an internal node. An external authority (A05) is never an ancestor of an internal node.
INV-1: tasking carries authority-to-direct, not authority-to-read.
